_about: Copy to sources.json at the project root. Each source is a script you already have. Two commands per source: `catalog` prints the option names the script accepts (one per line, optionally name<TAB>description, or JSON), `fetch` takes the chosen name and prints items (one per line, or JSON). Commands are argument lists, never shell strings, so a label the model picked can never become a shell command. The model chooses among exactly these names, which is why the catalog comes from the script and not from a hand-written list.

cisco.description: Cisco firewall: services and network events

db.description: Database records relevant to a message
db.format_note: JSON out is preferred; plain lines work too
